note: Example data: an invented online outdoor gear store with invented logs and accounts, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input. The log is shown after parsing: one line per client IP, URL and status with its hit count, plus hits per IP per day; the sitemap is shown as its index counts and the entries for URLs that appear in the log. Verified bot IPs sit inside the ranges Google, Bing, OpenAI, Anthropic and Perplexity publish; the fake ones use documentation-only IP ranges.
